visual_action: A slideshow of three images. The first is a screenshot of a news headline about musician Gracie Abrams and the band The National performing at a Harris-Walz rally, shown over a photo of Abrams singing and playing guitar. The second is a screenshot of a headline about Taylor Swift endorsing Harris, shown over a photo of Swift performing on stage. The third is a candid photo of Taylor Swift and Gracie Abrams walking together, with a blue heart emoji overlaid.

cast.name: Gracie Abrams
cast.evidence: Her name appears in a headline, "Gracie Abrams, Members of the National, to Perform at Harris-Walz Rally in Wisconsin," and she is shown in two photographs.

cast.name: The National
cast.evidence: The band is named in the on-screen headline: "Members of the National, to Perform at Harris-Walz Rally in Wisconsin."

cast.name: Kamala Harris
cast.evidence: Her name appears in two on-screen headlines: "Harris-Walz Rally" and "Taylor Swift endorses Harris."

cast.name: Tim Walz
cast.evidence: His name appears in the on-screen headline: "Harris-Walz Rally."

cast.name: Taylor Swift

on_screen_text.text: Gracie Abrams, Members of the National, to Perform at Harris-Walz Rally in Wisconsin
Taylor Swift endorses Harris in post signed 'Childless Cat Lady'

spoken_summary: At the end of the clip, a snippet of Taylor Swift speaking to a cheering crowd is layered over her music. She says, "And the fans... you have changed my life."
audio_music: Taylor Swift's song "Long Live" plays throughout the video. It is an anthemic, uplifting track. Towards the end, audio from a live performance featuring cheering crowds and Swift speaking is mixed in, creating a celebratory atmosphere.
central_claim: The Harris-Walz campaign is supported by popular and influential music artists like Taylor Swift, Gracie Abrams, and The National.
intended_effect: To generate excitement and support for the Harris-Walz ticket by associating it with beloved cultural figures.
